title: Convert Binary Search Tree to Sorted Doubly Linked List
goal: Convert a binary search tree into a sorted circular doubly linked list using the original nodes.
strategy: Inorder traversal gives sorted node order. Reuse each node by linking its left pointer to its predecessor and right pointer to its successor, then close the first and last links into a circle.
